buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original

delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 4. Generic End User Certificate: Wherever Bidders are insisting for End User Certificate from the Buyer, same shall be provided in Buyer’s standard format only. 5. Generic Installation, Commissioning, Testing, Configuration, Training (if any - which ever is applicable as per scope of supply) is to be carried out by OEM / OEM Certified resource or OEM authorised Reseller. 6. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 7. Generic NON DISCLOSURE DECLARATION CERTIFICATE (On Bidder Letter Head) to be uploaded with bid: 1. I M/s. 15 Fd Regt hereby declare that I shall not disclose the contract or any provision, specification, plan, design, pattern, sample or information thereof to any third party during and after expiry of Contract. 2. If defying the norms as per the Contract a legal action may be taken against me as per the existing Rules. 8. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 9. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion.

10. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 3 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 11. Scope and Applicability These Buyer Added Bid Specific Terms & Conditions (BA-BSTC) shall be read in conjunction with the General Terms & Conditions and Bid Document on Govern ment e-Marketplace (GeM). In case of any conflict, these conditions shall prevail. 2. Finality of Technical Parameters All technical specifications and performance parameters mentioned in the bid a re final and binding. Any deviation, shortfall, or non-compliance shall render the bid liable for outrigh t rejection. Buyer reserves full right to disqualify any bidder at any stage for non-complianc e. 3. Mandatory Pre-Bid Meeting & Equipment Demonstration A mandatory Pre-Bid Meeting will be conducted. All bidders must physically present their equipment for demonstration. This will include: * Physical inspection * Equipment display * Verification of technical parameters Failure to attend or demonstrate compliance will result in immediate disqualific ation.

Any discrepancy observed at this stage will be treated as final. 4. Field Trials & Performance Validation Shortlisted bidders shall undergo: * Ground testing * High altitude testing * Operational validation as per bid parameters Participation is mandatory. Failure to meet performance benchmarks will lead to disqualification. Buyer’s decision during trials shall be final and binding. 5. Buyer’s Right of Rejection Buyer reserves absolute right to: * Accept or reject any bid * Reject equipment at any stage * Cancel the procurement process This can be done without assigning any reason. Decision of the Buyer shall be final and binding. 6. Warranty & Performance Assurance Bidder shall provide minimum 24 months warranty. Warranty shall cover defects, failures, and performance issues. Equipment must perform in harsh and operational conditions. Failure during warranty will require repair/replacement as per GeM rules. 7. Compliance with GeM Guidelines All procurement shall follow GeM policies and Government rules.

Any violation may lead to disqualification, penalties, or blacklisting. 8. Documentation & Certification Bidders must submit: * Technical datasheets * Compliance matrix * Certificates Any false information will lead to immediate disqualification. 9. Indemnity Clause Bidder shall indemnify the Buyer against any failure, damage, or third-party clai ms arising from equipment usage. 10. No Deviation Clause No deviation from bid terms is allowed. Conditional bids will be rejected. 11. Force Majeure Applicable as per GeM rules. 12. Jurisdiction Subject to jurisdiction of competent auth as applicable to Buyer’s location. Operational Note: Buyer retains enhanced discretionary powers in evaluation, testing, and accept ance in view of operational and national security requirements. 13. Mode of Communication and Binding Nature All communication relating to the bid, including but not limited to pre-bid meeti ng, equipment display, clarification, field trial, test results, acceptance, rejectio n, or post-bid correspondence, shall be made only through official email, letter, postal communication, WhatsApp, telephonic communication, or any other med ium as decided by the Buyer.

Any communication issued through such authorized channels shall be treated a s valid, binding, and conclusive. No bidder shall claim ignorance of any communication so made. 14. No Oral Modification / No Informal Understanding No oral statement, informal discussion, assurance, clarification, or understandin g shall override the bid conditions, these Buyer Added Terms, or any written instruction issued by the Buyer. Only written communication from the authorized Buyer shall be binding. 15. Buyer’s Sole Discretion in Evaluation The Buyer shall have the sole and absolute discretion to interpret the bid conditi ons, assess compliance, determine suitability, and decide acceptability of the e quipment, documents, demonstrations, and trial results. The decision of the Buyer shall be final, conclusive, and binding. 16. Right to Seek Clarification or Additional Proof The Buyer reserves the right to seek any clarification, documentary proof, demo nstration, sample, technical explanation, manufacturer confirmation, OEM auth orization, or any other supporting material at any stage. Non-submission or unsatisfactory submission of such clarification may lead to di squalification. 17. Responsibility for Accuracy of Information The bidder shall be fully responsible for the correctness, authenticity, complete ness, and truthfulness of all information, documents, certifications, declarations , and technical claims submitted in the bid or during evaluation. Any false, misleading, incomplete, or suppressed information shall render the bi dder liable for rejection, cancellation, forfeiture, and other action as permissible under applicable rules. 18. Confidentiality and Security All bid-related information, technical parameters, trial procedures, evaluation m ethodology, test locations, and operational requirements shall be treated as con fidential. The bidder shall not disclose, publish, circulate, or share any such information w ith any third party without prior written approval of the Buyer. Any breach of confidentiality or security shall be viewed seriously and may lead to immediate disqualification and further action.

19. Communication Records and Evidence All records of email, WhatsApp messages, call logs, meeting minutes, attendanc e sheets, trial reports, photographs, videos, and other evidence generated duri ng the procurement process shall be maintained by the Buyer and shall be treat ed as official record for the purpose of evaluation and decision-making. The bidder shall not dispute the authenticity of such records merely on the grou nd that the communication was made through electronic or digital mode. 20. Authorized Representatives Only Only the bidder’s duly authorized representative shall be permitted to attend m eetings, demonstrations, trials, or communications with the Buyer. The Buyer shall not be bound by statements made by any unauthorized person. The bidder shall ensure that its representative is fully competent to answer all t echnical and commercial queries on behalf of the bidder. 21. Integrity, Fair Conduct, and Non-Influence The bidder shall not attempt to influence the procurement process directly or in directly through pressure, undue communication, inducement, representation, or any other means. Any act that, in the opinion of the Buyer, affects the fairness, integrity, or transp arency of the process shall be sufficient ground for disqualification. 22. No Waiver by the Buyer Failure or omission by the Buyer to enforce any clause, seek any remedy, or obj ect to any deviation at any stage shall not be treated as a waiver of the Buyer’s rights. The Buyer shall remain entitled to enforce any condition at any time in the inter est of procurement, security, and operational suitability. 23. Continuity of Obligation The obligations of the bidder regarding compliance, warranty, support, replace ment, confidentiality, and truthfulness shall continue even after placement of su pply order, delivery, inspection, acceptance, or payment, wherever applicable. 24. Reservation of Rights The Buyer reserves the right to modify, amend, withdraw, cancel, defer, split, or reschedule the procurement process, any stage of evaluation, or any trial condit ion, in whole or in part, at any time, without assigning reasons.

Such action shall not create any claim against the Buyer. 25. Interpretation and Prevailing Language In case of any ambiguity, inconsistency, or interpretational dispute, the interpre tation adopted by the Buyer shall prevail, subject to applicable law and GeM fra mework. The English version of these terms shall prevail over any other version. 26. Survival of Clauses Clauses relating to confidentiality, warranty, indemnity, liability, compliance, re cords, and dispute handling shall survive completion of delivery, acceptance, an d payment. 27. General Safeguarding Clause In addition to the above, the Buyer reserves the right to incorporate any further condition, safeguard, evaluation parameter, or procedural requirement found n ecessary in the interest of operational security, procurement integrity, technical assurance, and mission suitability. .
